data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at the current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and the reinsurers' share thereof. Included within claims notified of USD 1,547.3m (2022: USD 1,398.0m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2022 and prior years of account of USD 54.6m (2022: decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of account of USD 229.9m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss portfolio reinsurance contract (LPR) with another Lloyd's syndicate
prior_year_events.impact_description: Indemnified the Syndicate against potential adverse development in respect of net liabilities, providing protection in several professional lines portfolios predominantly relating to 2019 and prior years of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 into the 2019 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transferred responsibility for the discharging of liabilities of Syndicates 2007 and 6129 to the 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1686; financial impact stated as nil.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2023 the gross claims outstanding opening balance (1 Jan 2023) was USD 2,113.637m. The report does not present a single explicit gross prior-year development figure to quantify favourable or adverse movement solely relating to years prior to 2022; the notes state a decrease in claims notified of USD 54.6m relating to 2022 and prior years and describe a 2022 loss portfolio reinsurance (LPR) covering predominantly 2019 and earlier professional lines. A 2021 Reinsurance to Close (RITC) into the 2019 year is also disclosed (financial impact nil) and distorts the claims development triangle, so a definitive gross prior-year development amount is not extractable from the disclosed tables without significant distortion.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the native currency of the financial statements (USD). The report does not provide an explicit gross prior-year development figure solely isolating development on underwriting years prior to 2022. A gross claims development triangle is present but is affected by a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction and other adjustments (e.g. LPR) which distort comparisons; therefore a reliable gross prior-year development amount could not be extracted and is returned as null. The opening reserves figure is taken from the Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2023).
